from z3 import *

    result = sorted(result, key=lambda x: x["start_time"])
    print({"itinerary": result})
else:
    print("No solution found")

solver.add(current_time[0] == time_to_minutes("09:00"))

    solver.add(Implies(Not(meetings[person]), current_location[i + 1] == current_location[i]))

solver.maximize(objective)

    result = sorted(result, key=lambda x: x["start_time"])
    print({"itinerary": result})
else:
    print("No solution found")
